coverage.main: Read all fourteen pages of arXiv 2308.10299v3 (25 March 2024): Sections 1-5, Tables 1-4, Figures 1-5, references and Section 6 Appendix (Tables 5-7 for Inc-v4, IncRes-v2 and Res-101 sources; heatmap figures). The eleven-page CVPR 2024 open-access version was also retrieved; every one-decimal value in it also occurs in arXiv v3, which adds the appendix tables.
coverage.supplement: The appendix is embedded in arXiv v3 and read; the CVPR supplement was not retrieved separately.
coverage.excluded_results: White-box cells (source model columns) of Tables 1-3 and 5-7. Figures 1-2 and the appendix heatmaps are qualitative. The ~86.8% figure in Section 3 is the clean accuracy of Inc-v3 on transformed (not adversarial) images, a method diagnostic.

result_groups.population: 1,000 ImageNet validation images from 1,000 categories; single-model (Inc-v3, Inc-v4, IncRes-v2, Res-101) and ensemble sources; seven victims including three ensemble-adversarially trained models
result_groups.outcome: attack success rate: 'the misclassification rates of the victim model on the adversarial examples'
result_groups.evidence: No clean-correct filter or source-success rule is stated; the rate definition is a bare outcome definition.

result_groups.population: Same images; ensemble-source attacks against HGD, R&P, NIPS-r3, Bit-RD, JPEG, FD, RS, NRP

f1.evidence: No clean accuracy of any victim is reported.

f2.evidence: No clean-correct restriction or explicit inclusion statement.

f3.evidence: No source-success restriction or explicit inclusion statement.

f4.evidence: One-decimal rates; the 1,000-image set is described, but the rate denominator is not stated, and averages are included.

f5.evidence: MI-FGSM-based attacks with epsilon = 16, T = 10 for all experiments.

f6.evidence: The official repository provides mi_bsr.py, TF-slim model definitions and simple_eval.py; images and checkpoints must be obtained separately. Not executed.

artifact_checks.result: Linked in the paper. Listed via the GitHub API (head 28 February 2024): mi_bsr.py, simple_eval.py, nets/ (TF-slim architectures). No image list or checkpoints in the tree. Not executed.

bounds_checks.reason: No clean accuracy on the 1,000 images is reported.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit; coded consistently with ranks 42 and 21 (1,000-image ImageNet-compatible protocol without a stated population rule).
